status: declared by the pull request that closes #1072 before any number was computed; a measurement, not a record. Nothing is published, no day after 2025-12-31 is read (docs/decisions/lockbox.md), no rule changes. Development data gives a diagnosis, never a verdict (scoring protocol v1, #640; #46 top block).
hypothesis: H5 (primary goal), development step 3 (docs/research/hypotheses/H5.md): the 2021-23 floor diagnosis, a correction to the PIT diagnostic of #970
question: The target is a whole number of basis points. #970's randomised PIT draws inside the bracket of grid levels around the outcome, so it differs from the midpoint PIT only when a quantile ties the outcome exactly. Does the 2021-23 share of PIT at or below 0.10 move when the PIT is the proper one for an integer-valued outcome, on the lead-1 walks of the #1027 candidate?

input.walks: lead 1 only: gbm_funding (#634's walk, published panel), gbm_funding_cal_aligned and gbm_funding_cal_direct (the two variants of #1027, scratch panel AUG3), each walked as their scripts' docstrings say and read unchanged
input.cells: the target days every candidate has a law for, up to 2025-12-31 (refuse_locked); the decision day of a lead-1 cell is the business day before its target; the regime is that of the decision day (metadata/evaluation_splits.json)

pit.bracket_970: the randomised PIT of #970 (scripts/randomised_pit_970.py randomised_pit), unchanged: a draw uniform in the bracket of grid levels around the outcome
pit.integer: Czado, Gneiting and Held (2009) for an integer-valued outcome: a draw uniform in (F(y - 1/2), F(y + 1/2)), F the law's distribution function read off its 23 quantiles: linear between neighbouring quantiles, right-continuous, the largest level of tied quantiles at a tie, the mass below the first quantile at the first quantile and the mass above the last at the last (F is 0 below the first quantile and 1 from the last on)
pit.draw_order: cells sorted by (decision day, target day), one uniform draw each, from one random.Random(1072) per randomised version, for each candidate and cut in turn

reports: per candidate and per regime (all days and each regime of metadata/evaluation_splits.json): the share of PIT at or below 0.10 and the six bin shares, for the three versions side by side
2021-23: the proper PIT's share at or below 0.10 under 20 further seeds (1073 to 1092)
reading_rule: #970's rule, unchanged and applied to the proper PIT: the 2021-23 low-PIT reading stands if the proper share (seed 1072) is more than 0.15 and no seed of the 20 brings it to 0.10 or below; it does not stand if the share is 0.15 or below; anything else is unresolved. The PR states in words whether the 2021-23 share moves against the PIT of #970 and the midpoint PIT or stays. #984's page is not edited.
limits: No published declaration or record changes. #984's page and its record stand and are cited by the new page. Nothing after 2025-12-31 and no lockbox day is read (refuse_locked). The tails of F are a convention (point mass at the end quantiles); only a law narrower than its own outer quantiles is affected by it.
